```{=html}
<div id="publications-shell">
  <div class="pub-summary-bar">
    <div class="pub-stat">
      <div id="pub-total-count" class="pub-number">0</div>
      <div class="pub-label">Publications</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pub-stat">
      <div id="pub-citation-count" class="pub-number">0</div>
      <div class="pub-label">Citations</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pub-stat">
      <div id="pub-conf-count" class="pub-number">0</div>
      <div class="pub-label">Conference</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pub-stat">
      <div id="pub-journal-count" class="pub-number">0</div>
      <div class="pub-label">Journal / Review</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="pub-filters">
    <button class="pub-filter active" data-filter="all">All</button>
    <button class="pub-filter" data-filter="Conference">Conference</button>
    <button class="pub-filter" data-filter="Journal">Journal</button>
    <button class="pub-filter" data-filter="Review">Review</button>
  </div>

  <div id="publications-list"></div>
</div>
```

<script>
const PUBLICATIONS_CACHE_KEY = 'basu-publications-cache-v1';
const PUBLICATIONS_CACHE_TTL = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24; // 24 hours
const AUTHOR_ID = '3227042';
const MANUAL_PUBLICATIONS_URL = './manual_publications.json';

const apiUrl = `https://api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/author/${AUTHOR_ID}/papers?fields=title,year,venue,authors,citationCount,externalIds,publicationTypes,abstract,openAccessPdf&limit=100`;

function normalizePaper(paper) {
  return {
    title: paper?.title || '',
    year: Number(paper?.year || 0),
    venue: paper?.venue || '',
    authors: Array.isArray(paper?.authors)
      ? paper.authors.map(author => typeof author === 'string' ? { name: author } : author).filter(author => author?.name)
      : [],
    citationCount: Number(paper?.citationCount || 0),
    externalIds: paper?.externalIds || {},
    publicationTypes: Array.isArray(paper?.publicationTypes) ? paper.publicationTypes : [],
    abstract: paper?.abstract || '',
    openAccessPdf: paper?.openAccessPdf || null,
  };
}

function publicationKey(paper) {
  const doi = paper.externalIds?.DOI ? String(paper.externalIds.DOI).toLowerCase() : '';
  if (doi) return `doi:${doi}`;
  return `title:${paper.title.trim().toLowerCase()}|year:${paper.year || 0}`;
}

function mergePublications(primaryPapers, manualPapers) {
  const merged = new Map();

  [...manualPapers, ...primaryPapers]
    .map(normalizePaper)
    .filter(paper => paper.title)
    .forEach(paper => {
      merged.set(publicationKey(paper), paper);
    });

  return Array.from(merged.values()).sort((a, b) => {
    const yearDiff = Number(b.year || 0) - Number(a.year || 0);
    return yearDiff !== 0 ? yearDiff : paperTitleCompare(a.title, b.title);
  });
}

function paperTitleCompare(a, b) {
  return String(a || '').localeCompare(String(b || ''));
}

async function loadManualPublications() {
  const response = await fetch(MANUAL_PUBLICATIONS_URL, { cache: 'no-store' });
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Manual publications status: ${response.status}`);
  }

  const json = await response.json();
  return Array.isArray(json.papers) ? json.papers : [];
}

function renderYearSection(year, items) {
  const cards = items.map(item => {
    const authors = item.authors?.map(a => a.name === 'Aryabrata Basu' ? '<strong>Aryabrata Basu</strong>' : a.name).join(', ') || '';
    const venue = item.venue ? `<div class="pub-venue">${item.venue}</div>` : '';
    const pubTypes = item.publicationTypes || [];
    let pubType = 'Journal';
    if (pubTypes.includes('Conference')) pubType = 'Conference';
    else if (pubTypes.includes('Review')) pubType = 'Review';
    else if (pubTypes.includes('Book')) pubType = 'Book Chapter';

    const citationText = Number(item.citationCount || 0) > 0 ? `<span class="pub-cite">${item.citationCount} citations</span>` : '';
    const badgeClass = pubType.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-');
    const doi = item.externalIds && item.externalIds.DOI ? `https://doi.org/${item.externalIds.DOI}` : '';
    const pdf = item.openAccessPdf && item.openAccessPdf.url ? item.openAccessPdf.url : '';

    const links = [];
    if (doi) links.push(`<a href="${doi}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">DOI ↗</a>`);
    if (pdf) links.push(`<a href="${pdf}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">PDF ↗</a>`);

    const abstract = item.abstract ? item.abstract.trim() : '';
    const abstractBlock = abstract
      ? `
        <div class="pub-abstract-wrap">
          <button class="pub-abstract-toggle" type="button">Abstract ▾</button>
          <div class="pub-abstract hidden">${abstract}</div>
        </div>
      `
      : '';

    return `
      <article class="pub-item" data-type="${pubType}">
        <div class="pub-meta">
          <span class="pub-type ${badgeClass}">${pubType}</span>
          ${citationText}
        </div>
        <h3 class="pub-title">${item.title}</h3>
        <div class="pub-authors">${authors}</div>
        ${venue}
        <div class="pub-links">${links.join('')}</div>
        ${abstractBlock}
      </article>
    `;
  }).join('');

  return `
    <div class="pub-year-group">
      <div class="pub-year">${year}</div>
      <div class="pub-year-items">${cards}</div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function renderPublications(papers) {
  const container = document.getElementById('publications-list');
  if (!container) return;

  const byYear = {};
  papers.forEach(p => {
    const year = Number(p.year || 0);
    if (!year) return;
    if (!byYear[year]) byYear[year] = [];
    byYear[year].push(p);
  });

  const years = Object.keys(byYear).sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a));
  const html = years.map(year => renderYearSection(year, byYear[year])).join('');
  container.innerHTML = html;

  document.querySelectorAll('.pub-abstract-toggle').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const abstract = btn.nextElementSibling;
      const isHidden = abstract.classList.toggle('hidden');
      btn.textContent = isHidden ? 'Abstract ▾' : 'Abstract ▴';
    });
  });

  const total = papers.length;
  const totalCitations = papers.reduce((sum, p) => sum + Number(p.citationCount || 0), 0);
  const conferenceCount = papers.filter(p => (p.publicationTypes || []).includes('Conference')).length;
  const journalReviewCount = papers.filter(p => {
    const types = p.publicationTypes || [];
    return types.includes('JournalArticle') || types.includes('Review');
  }).length;

  document.getElementById('pub-total-count').textContent = total;
  document.getElementById('pub-citation-count').textContent = totalCitations;
  document.getElementById('pub-conf-count').textContent = conferenceCount;
  document.getElementById('pub-journal-count').textContent = journalReviewCount;
}

function filterPublications(type) {
  const items = document.querySelectorAll('.pub-item');
  items.forEach(item => {
    const match = type === 'all' || item.dataset.type === type;
    item.style.display = match ? '' : 'none';
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.pub-year-group').forEach(group => {
    const visible = group.querySelectorAll('.pub-item:not([style*="display: none"])').length;
    group.style.display = visible ? '' : 'none';
  });
}

document.querySelectorAll('.pub-filter').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.pub-filter').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    filterPublications(btn.dataset.filter);
  });
});

async function fetchPublications() {
  try {
    const manualPapers = await loadManualPublications().catch(() => []);
    const cached = localStorage.getItem(PUBLICATIONS_CACHE_KEY);
    if (cached) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
      const age = Date.now() - (parsed.cachedAt || 0);
      if (age < PUBLICATIONS_CACHE_TTL && Array.isArray(parsed.data)) {
        renderPublications(mergePublications(parsed.data, manualPapers));
        return;
      }
    }

    const response = await fetch(apiUrl, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0' } });
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`API status: ${response.status}`);
    }
    const json = await response.json();
    const papers = (json.data || []).filter(p => p && p.title);

    localStorage.setItem(PUBLICATIONS_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ cachedAt: Date.now(), data: papers }));
    renderPublications(mergePublications(papers, manualPapers));
  } catch (error) {
    try {
      const manualPapers = await loadManualPublications().catch(() => []);
      const fallback = await fetch('./publications_cache.json');
      const json = await fallback.json();
      renderPublications(mergePublications(json.papers || [], manualPapers));
    } catch {}
  }
}

fetchPublications();
</script>
